'''Paradise Planet''' was a [[Band/Legends|band]] that played in for [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in [[Nem'ro's Palace|his palace]] in [[Jiguuna]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The band consisted of a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] dancer, a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[strummer]], an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargonist]], and three [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] players. The band also had four groupies; a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] female and [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] female.<ref name="TOR" />
